_comment: Shared golden vectors for the calendar's month grid: how many empty cells
precede day 1 under the locale's first weekday, how many days the month has,
and how many cells the grid needs (whole rows of seven). Loaded by BOTH
MonthGridVectorTest.kt drives domain/MonthGrid.kt. Until the v0.86.0 review
Android computed the alignment twice, inline in two composables, with no
test; iOS had MonthGrid in the kit. This file is what makes the two the
same grid. February 2026 starts on a Sunday, which is the case that
separates a Monday-first from a Sunday-first locale most sharply.

cases.description: February 2026, Monday first: a Sunday start costs six blanks
February 2026, Sunday first: no blanks, exactly four rows
August 2026, Monday first: a Saturday start and 31 days need six rows
August 2026, Saturday first: the same month fits five rows
March 2026, Monday first: six blanks and 31 days
February 2024, Monday first: a leap month
December 2025, Monday first: a month starting on the first weekday
